basic_details.job_title: NIT Agartala JRF/ Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 - Walkin
basic_details.short_information: National Institute of Technology Agartala (NIT Agartala) has officially released the Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Project Assistant (PA) Recruitment 2026 notification (Advt. No. F. NITA/15 (7-CHEM)/ANRF Project/JRF/S. Kumar/2026) for 1 vacancy at NIT Agartala. Eligible candidates with an M.Sc. in Chemistry/Applied Chemistry with a valid CSIR-UGC NET and/or GATE qualification for the JRF post, or an M.Sc. in Chemistry or an equivalent degree for the Project Assistant post, can attend the walk-in interview. The age limit is as per the official notification. Selected candidates will be appointed

NIT Agartala JRF & PA Recruitment 2026 - Selection Process
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for NIT Agartala recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to attend the walk-in interview is 12 August 2026. Candidates are advised to reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What are the essential qualifications for the JRF/PA posts?
faq.answer: For JRF, an MSc in Chemistry/Applied Chemistry with valid CSIR-UGC NET and/or GATE is required. For PA, an MSc in Chemistry or an equivalent degree from a recognized university is sufficient.

faq.question: Q3. What is the salary offered for these positions?
faq.answer: The salary offered is Rs. 37,000/- + 10% HRA per month for JRF and Rs. 30,000/- + 10% HRA per month for PA.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q5. What is the selection process for the JRF/PA posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF)/Project Assistant (PA) posts will be based on an Interview.

faq.question: Q6. Where is the walk-in interview scheduled to be held?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held at National Institute of Technology Agartala, Agartala, Tripura, 799046.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should candidates carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, self-attested photocopies, and recent passport-size photographs. A duly filled application form might also be required.

faq.question: Q8. Is this a permanent government job?
faq.answer: No, this is a contractual job opportunity at the National Institute of Technology Agartala.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is F. NITA/15 (7-CHEM)/ANRF Project/JRF/S. Kumar/2026.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from other states apply for this position?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates meeting the eligibility criteria from any recognized university can apply for this position.
